verdict.rationale: Caveman applies here: it is itself a skill and a multi-agent workspace with team features. But the evidence never documents distributing a standard skill set across a team through a marketplace, a shared repo, or project-committed files. 'Plugins from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor' only shows plugin compatibility. The open-source repo containing a caveman.skill file is how Caveman itself ships, not a team distribution mechanism. Team features cover spend, budgets and roles, not skill distribution.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project
